event: Following the November 2 'Sparks of Weight-Space Programming' paper reporting that frontier models, in particular GPT-6 Astra, can read and write raw neural-network weights, Simon Willison reported on November 3, 2026 that Qwen 3.8 27B running locally on his laptop could also interpret model weights: given raw weights of small networks trained on simplified Breakout, Pong, Pac-Man and Freeway, it identified which game a network played, with each successful run taking tens of minutes. The replication reportedly suggests the weight-interpretation capability is not confined to the largest proprietary systems. (Alibaba (Qwen model), experiment run by Simon Willison, 2026-11-03.)
